messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: High OOM/error rate observed on serving-cluster-eastus-1 (paginated-attention allocator)
oncall-bot: Symptoms: repeated container restarts, CUDA OOMs, node flaps. 15+ pods restarted in last 10m. Auto-escalation to eng-oncall.
maria: I'm on it. seeing steady memory creep on kv cache slabs on nodes 3,4,7. not an immediate full OOM yet but fragmentation metric (kv_free_slots_ratio) trending downward.
raj: logs look like repeated small allocations not getting reclaimed. snippet:```E 03-15 10:12:01 cuda: allocation failed: out of memory
stack: serve::kv::alloc+0x3f4
serve::paged_attn::handle_page_fault+0xd2```
maria: thanks. hypothesis: a regression in the new prefetch logic from last deploy (rev 2026-03-14T22:00). deploy-bot: rollback available as rev-20260314-22:00 (manual).
sarah: customer-impact: a subset of requests are hitting 503s / timeouts, estimated 12% of p95 latency increase for chat endpoints in eastus. major customers routed there: acme-inc, nova-ai. pinged CS and sent out initial incident notice.
alex: live mitigation plan: 1) stop new prefetch ops (config toggle) 2) force kv compaction on affected nodes 3) scale down batch sizes to reduce new allocations 4) route traffic away from eastus while stabilizing
maria: applying toggle now:```curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/flags -d '{"prefetch_enabled":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'```
maria: running compaction on node-3:```ssh root@node-3 "/opt/redwood/bin/kvctl compact --slots 0-1023"```
raj: compaction started on 3,4. watching mem. if fragmentation persists we may need to cordon+drain node-7 and restart runtime to reclaim device-resident fragments.
sarah: routing change: shifting 30% traffic away from eastus to westus as a ramp, will monitor error rates and p95. (doing graceful reroute) :arrows_clockwise:
alex: rollback queued. if compaction + toggle don't show improvement in 10m, we'll roll back rev-20260314-22:00. deploy-bot: rollback started; progress 0/8 pods replaced.
maria: compaction on node-3 finished; observed immediate ~8% increase in kv_free_slots_ratio and small drop in device reserved. error rate down a bit. monitoring CPU/mem.
raj: node-4 compaction at 70%, node-7 compaction pending due to crashloop on runtime. logs show:```E runtime: broken page mapping, attempted free of already-freed slab at 0x7f8b...
E cuda: driver returned CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS```
maria: node-7 is in crashloop, cordoning+draining now:```kubectl cordon node-7 && kubectl drain node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data```
raj: drained node-7, recreated runtime pod with env REDWOOD_KV_COMPACT_FORCE=1 and reduced BATCH_MAX=32. new pod came up and passed health checks.
sarah: customer update draft prepared, will send once we hit stable for 20m. include root cause: allocator fragmentation and possible regression in prefetch module.
alex: post-mitigation next steps: 1) instrument finer-grained slab stats 2) run a canary load test on westus before re-routing back 3) triage commit on prefetch codepath 4) consider enabling periodic compaction job until fix is in.
maria: leaving oncall in 15m; handing to raj for follow-up and triage. raj: ack. I'll take visibility and the pager. adding label incident:kv-frag to the thread.
oncall-bot: Handoff: next oncall raj (primary), maria (secondary). Incident channel updated.
sarah: final note: CS notified large customers, exec update scheduled in 30m if still active. I'll prepare RCA timeline after triage. :memo:
